title: Improved Semidwarf Rice Lines with Tolerance to Submergence of Seedlings

passages.locator: pp. 749–751, abstract, Tables 1–2, and Methods text after Table 1
passages.quote: one breeding line with high submergence tolerance (IR49830-7-1-2-2) yielded 4880 kg ha−1
passages.note: Authors report 1990–1991 IRRI tests in Los Baños. FR13A contributed tolerance to the IR49830 cross through the intermediate IR26702. The tested high-performing IR49830-7-1-2-2 line is distinct from the later Swarna donor IR49830-7-1-2-3.
